control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during start-up after maintenance on CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 15 August 2015 a regulatory notice was issued concerning CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
